candidate_relations.reason: Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease and histiocytic necrotizing lymphadenitis are universally accepted synonyms for the same pathological entity. The candidate correctly identifies the disease and the affected site matches the clinical record (left axillary lymphadenopathy with coagulative necrosis, karyorrhexis, and lymphoplasmacytoid infiltrate, with negative mycobacterial workup and no autoimmune or lymphoproliferative cause found).
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease is the eponymous name for histiocytic necrotizing lymphadenitis; the anatomical qualifier (left axillary lymph node) is consistent with the clinical record and adds harmless specificity
